title: Iron Rusting: Oxygen & Water Requirement
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that simulates an interactive iron rusting chemistry lab experiment demonstrating that rust (iron oxide) forms ONLY when both oxygen AND water are simultaneously present.

SCENE SETUP:
- Dark lab background (color #1a1a2e). PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 4, 8) looking at origin.
- Ambient light (intensity 0.3) and a directional light from (5, 8, 5) with intensity 0.8 and shadow mapping enabled.
- A lab bench (flat box, 10x0.2x6, color #5c4033) at y=0.
- Three identical iron sample cubes (1x1x1) placed on the bench at x=-3, x=0, x=3 (y=0.6). Each starts as metallic gray (#808080). Label them Sample A, Sample B, Sample C using sprite text or HTML overlay divs positioned above each cube.
- Each sample has an independent environment: Sample A gets oxygen only, Sample B gets water only, Sample C gets both oxygen and water.

ENVIRONMENT CONTROLS (DOM buttons):
- A control panel (HTML div, id='control-panel') in the top-right corner with:
  - Button id='btn-add-oxygen' text 'Add Oxygen' — toggles oxygen presence globally (affects samples A and C)
  - Button id='btn-add-water' text 'Add Water' — toggles water presence globally (affects samples B and C)
  - Button id='btn-start-reaction' text 'Start Reaction' — begins the rusting simulation timer
  - Button id='btn-reset' text 'Reset Experiment' — resets everything to initial state
  - Button id='btn-speed-up' text 'Speed Up (2x)' — doubles the reaction speed multiplier
  - Button id='btn-analyze' text 'Analyze Samples' — triggers analysis mode showing rust percentage for each sample

RUSTING PHYSICS & CHEMISTRY:
- Rusting only progresses on a sample when BOTH oxygen AND water are present in that sample's environment.
- Sample A (oxygen only): no rusting. Sample B (water only): no rusting. Sample C (oxygen + water): rusting proceeds.
- When reaction is started and conditions are met, rust progresses from 0% to 100% over 10 seconds (at 1x speed).
- Rust percentage drives color interpolation: gray #808080 (0%) to rust-orange #8B4513 (50%) to deep rust-red #6B2A0A (100%).
- At every 10% rust increment on Sample C, emit 8-12 orange-brown particles (small spheres, radius 0.03) from random positions on the cube surface. Particles drift upward (y += random 0.5-1.5 per second) and fade out over 1.5 seconds, then are removed from the scene.
- Total particle count must be tracked. Particles must not exceed 200 alive at any time (recycle oldest if needed).

HUD DISPLAY:
- A HUD div (id='hud') at top-left showing:
  - 'Oxygen: ON/OFF'
  - 'Water: ON/OFF'
  - 'Reaction: IDLE/RUNNING/COMPLETE'
  - 'Speed: 1x/2x/4x' (btn-speed-up cycles through 1x->2x->4x->1x)
  - 'Time Elapsed: X.Xs'
  - 'Sample C Rust: XX%'

ANALYSIS MODE:
- When 'Analyze Samples' is clicked, display a results overlay div (id='analysis-overlay') showing:
  - Sample A rust%: should be 0% if only oxygen was added
  - Sample B rust%: should be 0% if only water was added
  - Sample C rust%: current rust percentage
  - A verdict: 'Rust requires both O₂ and H₂O' if C > 0 and A === 0 and B === 0

KEYBOARD INTERACTIONS:
- Press 'O' key to toggle oxygen (same as btn-add-oxygen)
- Press 'W' key to toggle water (same as btn-add-water)
- Press 'Space' to start/pause reaction
- Press 'R' to reset

STATE MANAGEMENT — expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
{
  oxygenOn: boolean,
  waterOn: boolean,
  reactionState: 'idle' | 'running' | 'paused' | 'complete',
  speedMultiplier: number (1, 2, or 4),
  timeElapsed: number (seconds, float),
  sampleA: { rustPercent: number, hasOxygen: boolean, hasWater: boolean, color: string (hex) },
  sampleB: { rustPercent: number, hasOxygen: boolean, hasWater: boolean, color: string (hex) },
  sampleC: { rustPercent: number, hasOxygen: boolean, hasWater: boolean, color: string (hex) },
  particleCount: number,
  totalParticlesEmitted: number,
  analysisVisible: boolean,
  analysisVerdict: string
}

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame. Ensure all numeric values are never NaN or Infinity. Rust percentages must be clamped 0-100.
physics_constraints: Rust formation requires simultaneous presence of O₂ and H₂O. Samples with only one reagent must show 0% rust at all times. Rust percentage monotonically increases (never decreases unless reset). Color interpolation must be continuous. Particle count bounded [0, 200]. Time elapsed must be monotonically non-decreasing during running state. Speed multiplier restricted to {1, 2, 4}.
